'''Cal-i-Vaun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Part of the [[Temple Security Force]], Cal-i-Vaun was stationed at a checkpoint at one of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] many entrances.

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Cal-i-Vaun was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Eventually, Cal-i-Vaun was elevated to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="CSWECite" /> In [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]], Cal-i-Vaun was manning a checkpoint in the Temple's [[Jedi Temple/Legends|docking complex]]. He stopped Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his Padawan, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], from entering without checking in first.<ref name="JA14" />
